text: dsh-chrome-attach（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把当前 Chrome 页面截图并放入 DSH 对话草稿，同时写入页面标题和地址。它在输入框的“+”菜单提供附加入口，并通过桥接命令、Chrome 调试协议或 macOS 窗口截图获取图像。适合需要把正在查看的网页带入对话、继续编辑后再发送的场景。截图在本机处理并作为普通附件进入草稿，不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-chrome-attach is a DSH web plugin that captures the current Chrome page and adds its image, title, and URL to the draft. Use the composer’s “+” menu. It tries the bridge, Chrome DevTools Protocol, or a macOS window screenshot. Edit and send when ready; no API key is needed.
想把当前 Chrome 网页截图放进 DSH 对话草稿。
能不能把浏览器页面连同标题和网址一起发给 DSH？
让 DSH 可以附上我正在看的 Chrome 页面截图。
dsh-chrome-attach 的功能「附加当前页面」：点击输入框“+”菜单中的 Chrome 操作，截取当前标签页并把 PNG 放入草稿，同时插入页面标题和 URL；内容仍可编辑，发送由用户触发。
dsh-chrome-attach 的功能「多通道截图」：自动依次尝试桥接、Chrome DevTools 协议和 macOS 窗口截图，成功后返回图像及页面标题、URL；也可通过模式设置固定通道。

dsh-chrome-attach README · dsh-chrome-attach：**Attach the current Chrome tab to your conversation.** One pick in the composer screenshots the page you are looking at, drops it into the draft as an image attachment, and types the tab's **title and URL** on a line next to it — the same move as ChatGPT's *+ → attach browser page*, except the model also learns *which* page it is looking at. Everything waits in the draft; nothing is sent until you press Enter.

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · a DeepSeek Harness plugin

dsh-chrome-attach README · dsh-chrome-attach：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chrome-attach)
[](https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach/releases)
[](LICENSE)

The plugin tries three capture tiers in order and uses the first one that works. **No bridge, no extension and no Chrome flags are required** — only the image quality differs:

dsh-chrome-attach README · dsh-chrome-attach：| Tier | What the image contains | Needs | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bridge` | tab content only | `dsh-chrome-bridge` + the DSH Bridge extension | best: no focus stealing, no prompt, supports full-page |
| `cdp` | tab content only | Chrome's own **Remote debugging** switch | one approval, keeps your normal profile |
| `window` | the whole Chrome window (**including** tab strip and address bar) | macOS + Screen Recording permission | no extension; briefly raises Chrome to the front |

dsh-chrome-attach README · dsh-chrome-attach：The default chain is `bridge → cdp → window`; the first tier that succeeds wins. Every response names its `source`, and a window shot is labelled *"window shot, browser UI included"*.

dsh-chrome-attach README · Install：Needs a DSH build that ships `commandUi` and the session-slot `inputActions` prop (that is what writes the page line). On older builds the screenshot still attaches; only the line is skipped, and the toast says so.

dsh-chrome-attach README · From npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chrome-attach   # "web" for the web profile
```

Then refresh the window (`Cmd+R`) or restart DSH — new bundles are not hot-loaded.

dsh-chrome-attach README · From a release tarball：1. Download `dsh-chrome-attach-<version>.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach/releases).
2. In DSH open **Plugins → Add plugin** and paste the tarball's absolute path.
3. Refresh the window (`Cmd+R`) or restart DSH — new bundles are not hot-loaded.

dsh-chrome-attach README · From source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach.git
```

Add the plugin by its absolute **directory** path. It installs as a `link:`, so edits to the code take effect after a restart:

```
/Users/you/WorkSpace/Github/dsh-chrome-attach
```

dsh-chrome-attach README · Use：The `+` menu in the composer gains one row, right below *Add files* in the Add section:

> **[Chrome mark] Attach Chrome** · *Screenshot the page, plus its title and URL*

Clicking it screenshots the active tab (or degrades to the window), puts the image into the current draft, writes the page line, and **does not send**. Keep typing. `/attach` works too.

dsh-chrome-attach README · Use：An image only tells the model what the pixels look like, not which page it came from, so the row also inserts one line through the composer's own input facade:

```
Chrome tab: Kaboo — https://kaboo.bytedance.net/?section=team
```

dsh-chrome-attach README · Use：That line and the image are one draft: it is plain text you can edit or delete, and both leave together when you press Enter. If the draft is mid-send or no editable draft is attached, only the image lands and the toast says the page line was skipped (`已附上（页面地址未能写入输入框）：…`).

Attachment names carry the page title, e.g. `DeepSeek-Harness-155812.png`.

Full-page capture exists in the API (`POST /api/chrome-attach/shot {"full":true}`) but is not a separate menu row yet.

dsh-chrome-attach README · 1. `bridge` — no permissions at all：Install `dsh-chrome-bridge` from the DSH plugin page and the **DSH Bridge** extension in Chrome, then connect once. The plugin shells out to the `cb` CLI (`~/.dsh/bin/cb`) and gets the bare tab content, without stealing focus.

dsh-chrome-attach README · 2. `cdp` — Chrome's own Remote debugging switch：The clean-tab fallback that needs no extension and no Screen Recording. Chrome 136 changed `--remote-debugging-port`, but Chrome now ships a supported switch instead:

dsh-chrome-attach README · 2. `cdp` — Chrome's own Remote debugging switch：1. Open `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` and tick **Remote debugging**.
2. Click **Attach Chrome** in DSH; the first connection asks once whether to allow the app — allow it.
3. Chrome writes the chosen port to `<profile>/DevToolsActivePort`, and the plugin reads it. Your profile, logins and extensions stay exactly as they are.

dsh-chrome-attach README · 2. `cdp` — Chrome's own Remote debugging switch：The switch is governed by the `DevToolsRemoteDebuggingAllowed` policy. On a managed machine where it is disabled the checkbox is greyed out — use the `window` tier or `bridge` instead.

Already launching Chrome with a debug port? The plugin also probes `9222`/`9223` and any port named by `DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT`:

```sh
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
  --remote-debugging-port=9222 \
  --user-data-dir="$HOME/.chrome-dsh-debug"
```

dsh-chrome-attach README · 3. `window` — macOS screen recording：Nothing to install inside Chrome; DSH needs Screen Recording once:

1. System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Screen Recording** → enable **DeepSeek Harness**.
2. Quit and reopen DSH (macOS requires a process restart for permission changes).
3. Pick **Attach Chrome page** from the `+` menu. The shot is the whole Chrome window.

dsh-chrome-attach README · 3. `window` — macOS screen recording：Window shots are downscaled to a 2200px long edge (about 1 MB on Retina, still readable). If another window covers Chrome, the plugin raises Chrome for the capture and switches back to DSH (roughly a second of focus switching). Google Chrome only.

dsh-chrome-attach README · How it works：```
browser (client/client.js)
  └─ menu row → POST /api/chrome-attach/shot {full}
        └─ host (lib/index.js → lib/capture.js)
              ├─ bridge: cb shot active --out … --json

dsh-chrome-attach README · How it works：The host half only imports Node built-ins, so it never depends on packages the DSH profile may not resolve. The client half is the entry in the `+` menu; it hands the PNG to the same attachment intake a real drag-and-drop uses. The page line goes through `inputActions`, the façade the conversation publishes to session slots as a prop — the plugin registers one headless `conversation.input.dock` entry to hold on to it, so it never reaches into the session directly and inherits the façade's phase/revision guards.

dsh-chrome-attach README · Configuration：| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_CHROME_ATTACH_MODE` | `auto` | Pin one tier: `bridge`, `cdp`, `window` |
| `DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT` | — | Extra CDP port to probe |
| `DSH_CHROME_BRIDGE_CB` | — | Explicit path to the `cb` CLI |
| `DSH_OSASCRIPT_BIN` / `DSH_SCREENCAPTURE_BIN` | system paths | Overrides for testing |

dsh-chrome-attach README · Limitations：- Captures only the **active tab** (`bridge`/`cdp`) or the **frontmost Chrome window** (`window`).
- The page line is typed into the focused draft, so it needs an editable composer; while a message is being sent the image attaches but the line is skipped (the toast says so).
- A `window` shot's URL/title come from the same page, so they describe the frontmost tab rather than the whole window.
- `chrome://` pages and the Chrome Web Store cannot be captured through `chrome.debugger`; the `window` tier is unaffected.
- The `window` tier needs Screen Recording; failures point at the exact System Settings pane.
- Images travel over a loopback route and are never uploaded; they end up as a normal DSH attachment.

dsh-chrome-attach README · Development：```sh
npm run check
```

Probe a single tier:

```sh
DSH_CHROME_ATTACH_MODE=window node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage())"
DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT=9222 node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage({mode:'cdp'}))"
DSH_CHROME_BRIDGE_CB=/path/to/fake-cb node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage({mode:'bridge'}))"
```

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chrome-attach)
[](https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach/releases)
[](LICENSE)

把**当前 Chrome 标签页**变成对话里的图片附件——ChatGPT 里「+ → attach 浏览器」的那个动作：截图、进草稿，同时把页面的 **标题和地址**写成一行文本，可继续打字，回车才发送。这样模型不只知道页面长什么样，还知道它是什么页面。

插件按能力自动降级，**没有 `dsh-chrome-bridge`、没有 DSH Bridge 扩展也能用**，只是截图质量不同：

dsh-chrome-attach README · dsh-chrome-attach：| 通道 | 截图内容 | 需要什么 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bridge` | 纯网页（无标签栏/地址栏） | 安装 `dsh-chrome-bridge` + DSH Bridge 扩展 | 体验最好：不抢焦点、不弹授权、支持整页 |
| `cdp` | 纯网页 | Chrome 自带「Remote debugging」开关 | 一次授权，保留登录态和扩展 |
| `window` | 整个 Chrome 窗口（**含**标签栏、地址栏、侧栏） | macOS + 屏幕录制权限 | 不需要扩展；会短暂把 Chrome 切到前台再切回 |

默认按 `bridge → cdp → window` 依次尝试，第一个成功的就用它；返回里带 `source`，窗口截图会在提示里标「窗口截图，含浏览器界面」。
dsh-chrome-attach README · 安装：需要带 `commandUi` 与会话槽位 `inputActions` 的 DSH 版本（页面行靠它写入）。更老的版本截图照常、只是不写这一行，提示里会说。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 从 npm 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-chrome-attach   # web 版 profile 写 web
```

然后**刷新窗口（Cmd+R）或重启 DSH**。新 bundle 不热加载。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 用 Release 里的 tgz：1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach/releases) 下载 `dsh-chrome-attach-<版本>.tgz`；
2. DSH 插件页 → **添加插件** → 粘贴这个 tgz 的绝对路径；
3. **刷新窗口（Cmd+R）或重启 DSH**。新 bundle 不热加载。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 从源码安装（开发用）：```sh
git clone https://github.com/deqingLv/dsh-chrome-attach.git
```

在插件页添加**目录**的绝对路径（`link:` 安装，改代码重启即生效）：

```
/Users/you/WorkSpace/Github/dsh-chrome-attach
```

dsh-chrome-attach README · 使用：输入框左下的 **`+`** 展开列表里多一行，紧挨在「添加文件」下面、「添加」组内：

> [Chrome 彩色标志] **附加 Chrome** · attach —— 截图当前页面，附带标题和地址

点它就会截当前活动标签页（或降级为窗口），图片进当前会话草稿，**不自动发送**，可以继续打字。也可以直接输入 `/attach` 回车。

图片本身不携带页面信息——模型只看得到像素，不知道这是哪个网址。所以这一行同时会通过输入框自己的 `inputActions` 门面向草稿里写一行文本：

```
Chrome 标签页：Kaboo — https://kaboo.bytedance.net/?section=team
```

这行和图片是同一份草稿：它是普通文字，可以随意编辑或删掉，回车时一起发出。如果草稿正在发送中、或当前会话没有可编辑草稿，就只有图片进去，提示里会写「已附上（页面地址未能写入输入框）：…」。

附件名带页面标题，例如 `DeepSeek-Harness-155812.png`。
dsh-chrome-attach README · 使用：整页截图目前只在接口层支持（`POST /api/chrome-attach/shot {"full":true}`），菜单里暂未单列一行。
dsh-chrome-attach README · 1. `bridge`：零权限，体验最好：在 DSH 插件页安装 `dsh-chrome-bridge`，并在 Chrome 里装好 **DSH Bridge** 扩展，点一次连接。插件调用 `cb` 命令（`~/.dsh/bin/cb`）拿到纯网页，不抢焦点。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 2. `cdp`：Chrome 自带的 Remote debugging 开关：不需要扩展，也不需要屏幕录制。Chrome 136 收紧了 `--remote-debugging-port`，但 Chrome 现在自带一个开关：

1. 打开 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging`，勾选 **Remote debugging**；
2. 在 DSH 里点「附加 Chrome」，首次连接会弹一次授权，允许即可；之后保持常驻连接，不再弹；
3. Chrome 把选中的端口写进 `<profile>/DevToolsActivePort`，插件自动读取。登录态、标签页、扩展都不受影响。

这个开关受策略控制（`DevToolsRemoteDebuggingAllowed`）；公司设备上被策略禁用时勾选框是灰的，此时只能走 `window` 通道或 `bridge`。

已经在用调试端口启动 Chrome 的，插件也会探测 `9222`/`9223`，以及 `DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT` 指定的端口：
section: 2. `cdp`：Chrome 自带的 Remote debugging 开关

dsh-chrome-attach README · 2. `cdp`：Chrome 自带的 Remote debugging 开关：```sh
"/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
  --remote-debugging-port=9222 \
  --user-data-dir="$HOME/.chrome-dsh-debug"
```
section: 2. `cdp`：Chrome 自带的 Remote debugging 开关

text:
dsh-chrome-attach README · 3. `window`：macOS 窗口截图（零 Chrome 改动）：什么都不用装，只需要给 DSH 授一次屏幕录制权限：

1. 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → **屏幕录制** → 勾选 **DeepSeek Harness**；
2. 完全退出并重开 DSH（macOS 对权限变更要求进程重启）；
3. 从 `+` 菜单选「附加 Chrome 页面」。截图是 Chrome 窗口整体，包含标签栏、地址栏和侧栏。

窗口截图会缩到长边 2200px（Retina 下约 1 MB，仍足够看清页面）。窗口被其它窗口挡住时，插件会先把 Chrome 切到前台再抓屏，然后切回 DSH（约 1 秒的焦点切换）；只支持 Google Chrome。
section: 3. `window`：macOS 窗口截图（零 Chrome 改动）

text:
dsh-chrome-attach README · 工作原理：```
浏览器（client/client.js）
  └─ 点按钮 → POST /api/chrome-attach/shot {full}
        └─ Host（lib/index.js → lib/capture.js）
              ├─ bridge: cb shot active --out … --json

Host 侧只用 Node 内置模块，不 import profile 里可能解析不到的包。客户端只负责 `+` 菜单里的那一行，图片交给和真实拖拽相同的附件入口；那一行文本则走 `inputActions`——会话通过 slot prop 提供给插件的输入门面。插件注册一个无界面的 `conversation.input.dock` 条目把它交到手里，因此不直接碰会话，也自动继承门面的阶段/版本校验。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 配置：| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_CHROME_ATTACH_MODE` | `auto` | 固定通道：`bridge` / `cdp` / `window` |
| `DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT` | — | 额外探测的 CDP 端口 |
| `DSH_CHROME_BRIDGE_CB` | — | 显式指定 `cb` 路径 |
| `DSH_OSASCRIPT_BIN` / `DSH_SCREENCAPTURE_BIN` | 系统路径 | 测试用覆盖 |

dsh-chrome-attach README · 已知限制：- 只截**当前活动标签页**（`bridge`/`cdp`）或**当前 Chrome 窗口**（`window`）。
- 那行页面信息是写进当前焦点的草稿的，所以需要草稿可编辑；正在发送时图片照样进，这一行会跳过（提示里会说明）。
- `window` 通道的标题/地址取自最前面那个标签页，描述的是页面而不是整个窗口。
- `chrome://`、Chrome 应用商店等受保护页面无法通过 `chrome.debugger` 截图；`window` 模式不受此限制。
- `window` 模式需要屏幕录制权限；首次失败会给出系统设置路径。
- 图片走本机回环路由，不上传；最终以 DSH 附件形式落盘。

dsh-chrome-attach README · 开发：```sh
npm run check
```

单独验证某一通道：

```sh
DSH_CHROME_ATTACH_MODE=window node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage())"
DSH_CHROME_DEBUG_PORT=9222 node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage({mode:'cdp'}))"
DSH_CHROME_BRIDGE_CB=/path/to/fake-cb node -e "import('./lib/capture.js').then(m => m.capturePage({mode:'bridge'}))"
```
dsh-chrome-attach README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)
